title: 07/17/2026 - Software Updates
text:
## 07/17/2026 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000109204
We made updates to several default widgets this week. If you customized any of these widgets and want to update them, you can find the latest code in the corresponding default widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, the latest updates will not be pushed to your website.
Released the ability for BD Butler to run recurring tasks, skills, and routines automatically on a schedule.
Released the ability to assign a custom member signup form to each Membership Plan, allowing each plan to have its own signup experience. To use this new feature, navigate to Admin >> Finance >> Membership Plans >> Edit >> Sign Up Settings.
Updated the " Enable Private Chat Messages" Membership Plan setting into two separate options, allowing Admins to control whether members can send and receive private chat messages independently. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Sidebar Bootstrap Theme - Contact Member Modal Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Contact Page Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Header Bootstrap Theme - Module - Private Member Chat
Added a new " Self Signup Via Claim Listing " option to the " Joined Via " filter when searching members in the Admin, making it easier to identify members who joined by claiming a listing. This will apply to all future members who claim a listing after this update was made.
Added help article links to each update listed in the Install New Updates section of the Admin Dashboard, allowing Admins to learn what each update does before installing it.
Improved the Private Member Chat system to link chat messages directly to member accounts for more reliable message tracking. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Sidebar
Fixed an issue that prevented the "Dynamic Category Filter - Top + Sub Level Category" widget from appearing in the Available Widgets list of the Sidebar Manager in the Admin.
Fixed an issue that caused the " One Post per Member " Design Setting to display multiple posts from the same member in the Recent Blog Articles with Sidebar widget. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Blog Articles with Sidebar
Fixed an issue that caused the website's Organization SEO schema to display incorrect address information. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Global Website - Schema Markup
Fixed an issue that prevented the Email Template Logo Max Width setting from applying values above 350 pixels to the logo displayed in emails. Widget Involved: Default Email Template
Fixed an issue that caused mandatory form fields to lose their red error highlight while typing when the field's character limit was exceeded. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Form
Fixed an issue that prevented custom inline CSS styles added to Menu items from being applied when the style value was formatted with mismatched or missing quotation marks.
Fixed an issue that prevented Admins from saving changes on the Member Categories page in the Admin in some cases.
Fixed an issue that prevented the system from automatically redirecting members after completing a Pay Per Post payment in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Success Page - Pay Per Post
Fixed an issue that caused keyword searches by a member's last name to return no results when searching Private Chat Messages in the Admin .
Fixed an issue that caused keyword searches in the Private Member Chats section of the Admin to return duplicate or inconsistent results. Additionally, added a dropdown with more filtering options for chat searches.
Fixed an issue that caused the system to apply the free trial settings of a member's previous Membership Plan when upgrading to a new plan with a free trial in some cases.
Fixed an issue that caused the Admin Dashboard to time out for accounts with a large number of pending websites.
Fixed an issue that caused new self-signup subscriptions to remain in Pending status, preventing free trials from activating in some cases.
